concepts.title: Codex 空中光弹
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: a polished, beautiful airborne-combat visual design for the game Pelican 429, single wide 16:9 landscape image, NOT a collage.
Reference images: input 1 is the locked character/keyboard design and materials; input 2 is the compact flight apparatus and floating body proportion reference. Preserve the same specific face, large brown eyes, sculpted dark brown hair, red knit sweater, rolled blue jeans, white sneakers, 3.1-head cute stylized body, compact white/graphite/cyan wrist armor, straps and paired waist/back propulsion pods. No costume changes. Round high quality stylized 3D sculpting and fabric, not a tall realistic adult.
Hero is clearly AIRBORNE DURING TAKEOFF: both feet entirely off the ground, one knee lifted more than the other, body leaning dynamically and rotating toward an opponent, propulsion jets CONTINUE WHILE ATTACKING. Waist/back jets point downward with distinct bright cyan cores and snowy blue particles; small displaced dust cloud and separated shadow far below. Wrist effects never obscure keyboard grip. Lift supplied mainly by the compact waist/back pods while arms attack. Full body, all equipment and projectile endpoints framed. Keep face and red sweater readable.
Scene: restrained deep-blue sci-fi training arena with subtle floor depth, a few softly lit panels, no busy environment. Cinematic crisp render, directional rim light, controlled bloom. Skill particles MUST be obvious at thumbnail size: an intentional mix of sharp bright medium-sized flecks, larger polygon flakes and smaller dust, saturated colored borders, asymmetrical turbulence, persisting trails and separate impact burst; never just a faint line. Preserve solid opaque silhouette of weapon/projectiles within glow. No gore, no watermark, no other characters except specified enemy training robot, no unrelated objects.
Primary request: RE-DESIGN THE CODEX ATTACK to be gorgeous and powerful, with REAL SOLID LIGHT-BOLT BODIES PLUS VISIBLE PARTICLES, matching the wonderful white-cyan bolt aesthetic of input1 but more dramatic and richer. Hero occupies left third, hovering/lifting off, holding the mechanical keyboard with left forearm supporting its edge and right fingers pressing illuminated keys. This is a keyboard ranged attack, not a gun. White/silver rectangular keyboard and raised black/gray keys unmistakable.
From the FAR EDGE of keyboard, shoot a beautiful fan of FIVE large sculpted blue-white crystal-like light projectiles toward camera-right. Each long faceted opaque/semitranslucent projectile has a sharp recognizable diamond/spearhead volume with angular cyan outer facets, concentrated white core, deep sapphire underside and visible surfaces; the largest around the length of hero's torso. Show foreground and background layers, good spacing, different travel positions, long reach across 2/3 of composition. NO undifferentiated beam.
Every bolt has a long thick tapering layered trail of bright white core streaks, cobalt outer glow and hundreds of DISTINCT luminous blue/white particles peeling off in turbulent wakes. LARGE cyan diamond/code-bracket fragments intermixed with smaller sparks stay visible in dark negative space. Use irregular clumped distribution, bright headed streaks, floating 3D square flakes, NOT dotted ruler lines or uniformly spaced sprites. A compact emission bloom at keyboard, the 5 solid travelling bolts, residual drifting fragments behind them, and a distant shower against a faceted gray hovering target/drone on far right must all be visible simultaneously.
The impact at far right explodes into blue shards and outward sparks plus a thin short-lived pressure ring. Pose, face, keyboard and the solid bolt silhouettes stay clear despite densely visible luminous particles. Gorgeous strong blue-white contrast, saturated but controlled. Minimal small header upper-left exactly “CODEX · 空中光弹”. No extra labels.

Primary request: Re-design BUG ATTACK as a beautiful high-tech summoned mechanical beetle swarm, distinct from Codex light bolts. Hero at left lifts off while typing a green illuminated command on the white/silver mechanical keyboard. Left arm supports keyboard, right hand activates keys. Clearly visible waist thrust stays CYAN; attack colors are VIOLET and ELECTRIC LIME only.
Attack traverses most of image from keyboard toward far right, like THREE fluid braiding streams that break into a swirling attack flock near the distant gray armored hovering training target. Show FOUR prominent medium/large jewel-like solid mechanical scarab drones, each about one quarter hero height, plus a dozen smaller drones behind. Beautiful curved dark graphite/violet shells with beveled metallic edges, segmented 6 legs tucked into aerodynamic flying posture, two translucent purple wing pairs, very clear lime eyes and luminous circuit abdomen. Crafted purposeful sci-fi beetles, no creepy flesh, no generic flies, no floating featureless orbs. Keep each main insect clearly separated and recognizable, most facing or banking toward right.
Each drone sheds a RICH visible trail of luminous lime micro-sparks, medium emerald glints, purple pixel shards, short disintegrating error-bracket fragments, and fine vapor wisps. Hundreds of DISTINCT particles fill the braid's wake and slowly scatter into the negative space, visibly lingering behind the beetles. Beautiful curved fluid paths, dense bright centers with looser outward scatter and multiple particle sizes, not a single neon ribbon. Preserve dark purple solid shells inside the glow so entity and particle are both equally clear.
At far right the target is being struck by a blooming lime-white digital splinter explosion and violet shards. A few drones arc around the impact for sense of coordinated tracking. Prioritize elegance and readable silhouettes over noisy clutter, do not obscure hero face. Full trajectory and separate jets visible, strong scale and motion. Small crisp header exactly “BUG · 空中虫群”. No extra labels.

Primary request: AIRBORNE SINGLE-HANDED KEYBOARD MELEE. A wide beautiful dynamic illustration of Grassy performing a one-handed backhand keyboard WHACK during takeoff, the keyboard itself physically hitting an enemy in midair. Reference image 3 supplies the accepted SINGLE-HAND end grip and weapon mechanics, but change posture to clear airborne twisting action. No typing or ranged projectile in this image.
Full hero in left/center, waist pods blazing downward while he floats at least 0.8 body heights off ground, bent asymmetric knees drifting behind him, midair shoulder/hip counter-rotation with readable weight. His RIGHT hand tightly grabs ONLY ONE SHORT END / corner of the rectangular solid keyboard, fingers curled underneath the casing, thumb on top. The entire long keyboard extends away from the fist toward camera-right like a paddle. No invented sword, no added handle, it is recognizably a full keyboard with black/gray keys and silver casing. His LEFT hand is OPEN and stretched far behind him for balance, clearly separated by wide negative space, touching NOTHING. One hand on keyboard only. Exact character proportions and believable anatomy.
At the extreme extension of his sweeping right arm the keyboard's DISTAL OUTER CORNER physically strikes the upper chest/shoulder armor of a full gray hovering humanoid training robot on the far right. The robot recoils backwards in air, limbs thrown outward, sparkling contact and a few flying metal chips. No blood. Keyboard hitting the enemy, not hero's fist. Contact point away from face. The swing is a huge clearly curved broad arc starting behind his shoulder, not an arm shove or sliding/rubbing. Bright narrow cyan crescent trails BEHIND the weapon, with white/cyan glitter trailing off and concentrated orange impact sparks at contact, controlled bloom leaves HAND GRIP visible. Cloth and hair respond to twist and thrust. Jet plumes remain pointed downward, not into enemy.
Clear artistic separation between cyan lift exhaust under hero, blue curved swing wake, and orange impact burst on enemy. A couple large chipped keycap-like fragments may fly but keyboard remains intact. Keep whole hero, whole keyboard and target torso within frame. Small header exactly “空中单手挥击”. No other labels.

Primary request: SERVER OVERLOAD ultimate, now cast DURING TAKEOFF / IN MID-AIR while propulsion remains on. Grand intense spectacular but beautifully controlled 3D game VFX concept, much larger than ordinary skills. Single wide cinematic image, low three-quarter view.
Hero floats in CENTER foreground at a clearly visible height above ground, legs asymmetrically bent, both sneakers well off floor, red sweater and expressive face fully readable; keyboard supported on left forearm, right hand striking the illuminated ENTER key. Compact waist/back flight pods continue bright cyan downward jets with blue snowlike particles. He must not stand on any platform or energy ring.
SIX physically solid large DARK GRAPHITE SERVER RACKS levitate in a semicircle behind and to either side of hero. Each about 1.2 hero heights, clearly has stacked vented machine modules, layered edge bevels, rails, cables, blue-to-amber-to-red LED rows; substantial volumetric hardware with detailed hard-surface materials, not icons or stone pillars. All server racks clearly float above floor and frame hero without covering his head.
At the dramatic overload release moment the servers arc electricity into a central white-cyan energy column behind hero. Bright electrical filaments branch between racks. An enormous expanding orange-gold circular shockfront centered AT HERO'S AIRBORNE HEIGHT blasts outward through the suspended racks; elliptical perspective shows its width across almost whole arena. Lower secondary cyan pressure ring expands toward floor, but main explosive center clearly follows airborne hero rather than being rooted to ground.
RICH highly visible particles: hundreds of sharp orange sparks and cyan electric specks at multiple sizes, big bright scattered cuboid metallic shards with orange-hot edges, angular floating pixel fragments, lightning splinters and faint vapor. Randomized physical outward motion and luminous drifting residues. White-hot compact ignition core and saturated warm-red warning lights, contrasting cool blue flight exhaust. Main shock ring solid bright short rim, fine turbulent particle wake peels behind it. Scale dramatic, real solid server shapes preserved; do not flood everything with featureless bloom.
Two small distant gray training robots at far edges visibly blasted outward, no blood, secondary. Beautiful balanced composition and generous separation around hero face. This is the strongest ultimate, not a tranquil ritual circle. Header exactly “服务器超载 · 空中释放”. No other text, no control UI.
